description_en: Lists all managed rules under Web Application Firewall (WAF) or filters rules based on specific conditions. You can use this operation to query detailed information about WAF managed rules in a paginated manner
description_zh: 列出Web应用防火墙（WAF）下的所有托管规则或根据特定条件筛选规则，用户可以使用此接口以分页形式查询WAF托管规则的详细信息
name: ListWafManagedRules

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can obtain the site ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the WAF rule
parameters.name: id

fields.help_en:
The unified action when ProtectionLevel is greater than 0. This parameter cannot be empty in this case.

Common valid values: monitor, deny, js, captcha. The actual available values depend on the instance quota
fields.help_zh:
当 ProtectionLevel > 0 时的统一处置动作，此时不可为空。

常用取值：monitor、deny、js、captcha 等，实际可用值取决于实例配额
fields.name: action

fields.help_en:
The attack type encoding. The value cannot be 0.

Example values: 11 (SQL injection), 12 (XSS), 13 (code execute), 14 (CRLF), 15 (local file inclusion (LFI)), 16 (remote file inclusion (RFI)), 17 (WebShell), 22 (command injection), 26 (SSRF), 27 (path traversal), 28 (protocol violation), 31 (scanner behavior)
fields.help_zh:
攻击类型编码，不可为 0。

取值示例：11（SQL 注入）、12（XSS）、13（代码执行）、14（CRLF）、15（本地文件包含）、16（远程文件包含）、17（WebShell）、22（命令注入）、26（SSRF）、27（路径穿越）、28（协议违规）、31（扫描器行为）等
fields.name: attack_type

fields.help_en:
The action for a single rule. This parameter takes effect only in custom mode (ProtectionLevel = -1).

Common valid values: monitor, deny, js, captcha. The actual available values depend on the instance quota
fields.help_zh:
单条规则的处置动作，仅在自定义模式（ProtectionLevel = -1）下生效。

常用取值：monitor、deny、js、captcha 等，实际可用值取决于实例配额
fields.name: action

fields.help_en: The unique ID of a single managed rule
fields.help_zh: 单条托管规则的唯一标识 ID
fields.name: id

fields.help_en:
The rule enabled status.

Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
fields.help_zh:
规则启用状态。

取值：on（启用）、off（禁用）
fields.name: status

fields.help_en:
The rule configuration list in custom mode. This parameter is used only when ProtectionLevel is set to -1.

Each element contains Id, Status, and Action, which are used to specify the enabled status and action for each managed rule
fields.help_zh:
自定义模式下的规则配置列表，仅当 ProtectionLevel 为 -1 时使用。

每个元素包含 Id、Status 和 Action，用于逐条指定托管规则的启用状态和处置动作
fields.name: managed_rules

fields.help_en:
The protection level within the ruleset.

Valid values: -1 (custom mode, specify each rule through ManagedRules), 1 (loose), 2 (medium), 3 (strict), 4 (super strict).

When the value is -1, ManagedRules cannot be empty. When the value is greater than 0, Action cannot be empty
fields.help_zh:
规则集内的防护等级。

取值：-1（自定义模式，通过 ManagedRules 逐条指定）、1（宽松）、2（中等）、3（严格）、4（超严格）。

当值为 -1 时，ManagedRules 不能为空；当值 > 0 时，Action 不能为空
fields.name: protection_level

parameters.help_en:
The managed ruleset configuration in JSON string format.

Contains the AttackType, ProtectionLevel, Action, and ManagedRules subfields. When ProtectionLevel is set to -1 (custom mode), specify the status and action for each rule through the ManagedRules array
parameters.help_zh:
托管规则集配置，JSON 字符串格式。

包含 AttackType、ProtectionLevel、Action 及 ManagedRules 子字段。当 ProtectionLevel 为 -1（自定义模式）时，需通过 ManagedRules 数组逐条指定规则状态和动作
parameters.name: managed_ruleset

parameters.help_en:
The attack type of the vulnerability prevention event. Valid values:
SQL injection
cross-site scripting (XSS)
code execute
CRLF
local file inclusion (LFI)
remote file inclusion (RFI)
webshell
cross-site request forgery
Others
SEMA
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞防护事件的攻击类型。取值：
SQL注入
跨站脚本
代码执行
CRLF
本地文件包含
远程文件包含
webshell
跨站请求伪造
其他
SEMA
parameters.name: attack_type

parameters.help_en:
The currently saved protection level, which represents the existing configuration state in the database.

Valid values: -1 (custom mode), 1 (loose), 2 (medium), 3 (strict), 4 (super strict).

Difference from ManagedRuleset.ProtectionLevel: this parameter indicates the currently effective configuration, while ManagedRuleset.ProtectionLevel indicates the target value being passed in
parameters.help_zh:
当前已保存的防护等级，代表数据库中已存在的配置状态。

取值：-1（自定义模式）、1（宽松）、2（中等）、3（严格）、4（超严格）。

与 ManagedRuleset.ProtectionLevel 的区别：本字段是当前已生效的配置，ManagedRuleset.ProtectionLevel 是传入的目标值
parameters.name: protection_level

parameters.help_en:
The language type. The response is returned in the specified language. Valid values:

en: English.
zh: Chinese
parameters.help_zh:
语言类型，将以此语言返回。取值范围：

en：英文。
zh：中文
parameters.name: language

fields.help_en: Fuzzy match by rule ID or rule name
fields.help_zh: 模糊查询规则id或规则名称
fields.name: id_name_like

fields.help_en: The list of rule protection levels
fields.name: protection_levels

Action.description_en: The protection action of the managed rule

ProtectionLevel.description_en: The protection level of the managed rule

Status.description_en: The protection status of the managed rule

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of rules after filtering
